entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Agent' to speak with a representative.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, I think I need to return my VeloBand. I'm just so confused by the whole process.
I can certainly help you with that. Just to make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band or more of a preference?

Oh, it works fine, I think. It's just... I guess I **changed my mind**. It was a total **impulse buy** for the new year, and I just **don't use it**. I tried looking on the website but it all seemed so complicated. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm here to make this easy for you. It's no problem at all. Let me just pull up your order details. One moment please.
Alright, I see your order. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered 17 days ago. Let me just check our return policy...

Okay, great news. Our policy states you have 90 days to return an item. You're well within that window, so we can definitely process a full refund. No need for you to worry about trying to find a **resale** marketplace or anything like that.
Oh, really? Ninety days? That's... a huge relief. I was so worried I had missed the deadline. Thank you so much!

You are very welcome. I've gone ahead and authorized the return for you. I'm sending an email to you now with a pre-paid shipping label. Just place the VeloBand back in its original packaging, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office.
Wow. That's it? That was so much easier than I thought. Thank you again, Diana.
It was my pleasure to help. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
Wonderful. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
